name: Gitea
description: Your own GitHub: git hosting, issues, pull requests. Good home for RPC-Workspace.
compose:
services:
  gitea:
    image: gitea/gitea:latest
    container_name: gitea
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "{PORT}:3000"
      - "2222:22"
    environment:
      USER_UID: "1000"
      USER_GID: "1000"
    volumes:
      - {DATA}:/data
